name: Painted Memory
source:
You are a painter.

She is the lady you do not remember painting.

In art, remember your reality. 

[from [url=https://almanak-games.itch.io/painted-memory]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名画家。

而她，是那位你并不记得自己曾画下过的女子。

于画境之中，忆起你的现实。

[摘自[url=https://almanak-games.itch.io/painted-memory]itch.io[/url]]
